title: Is PS5 Pro Worth It for GTA 6? 30 FPS, PSSR and What You Actually Get
desc: GTA 6 runs at 30 FPS on every console, PS5 Pro included. What the Pro actually improves (sharper image, ray-traced shadows, steadier frame rate), who should upgrade, and who shouldn't.
lede: Short answer: the PS5 Pro is the best place to play GTA 6, but it doesn't get you 60 FPS. Every console runs the game at 30 FPS. Here's what the Pro changes, based on Digital Foundry's testing as reported this week.
sections: Rockstar confirmed a 30 FPS target, and there's no performance mode on PS5, PS5 Pro or Xbox Series X|S.

• A sharper image with PSSR upscaling.
  • Ray-traced shadows.
  • Steadier performance: the base PS5 can dip into the low 20s in heavy action, according to Digital Foundry's testing.

• Buying a console for GTA 6 anyway: the Pro is the best version. See PS5 Pro (affiliate).
  • Already on a base PS5: the game is fully playable; the Pro is a nice-to-have, not a must. A storage upgrade (affiliate) may matter more for the 212 GB install.
  • On Xbox Series S: it's the weakest version, per the same testing; Series X or PS5 Pro look clearly better.
Consoles and bundles often drop on Black Friday (November 27, 2026). Our Black Friday page tracks what's worth it for GTA 6.
faq: Does GTA 6 run at 60 FPS on PS5 Pro?
No. GTA 6 runs at 30 FPS on every console, including PS5 Pro. Rockstar confirmed the 30 FPS target.
Is GTA 6 better on PS5 Pro?
Yes: Digital Foundry's testing, as reported, found a sharper image with PSSR, ray-traced shadows and steadier performance than base PS5.
Which console is worst for GTA 6?
The Xbox Series S struggles the most, according to the same Digital Foundry testing.
